name: Line Leader
description: Leads the class quietly in the hallway to specials, lunch, and recess.

name: Door Holder
description: Holds classroom and hallway doors open safely for the entire class.

name: Paper & Materials Passer
description: Hands out worksheets, notebooks, and art supplies to each desk cluster.

name: Tech Specialist
description: Manages Chromebook cart, plugs in chargers, and assists with projector.

name: Whiteboard Cleaner
description: Erases the board at the end of lessons and organizes markers.

name: Classroom Librarian
description: Organizes the reading corner by genre and checks book bins.

name: Pencil Sharpener & Supply Boss
description: Sharpens dull pencils for the class community jar each morning.

name: Lunch Cart Leader
description: Inspects cafeteria table cleanliness and helps wipe down desks.

name: Calendar & Morning Announcer
description: Updates the daily date, weather tracker, and daily schedule board.

name: Substitute & Teacher Assistant
description: Guides visitors, takes attendance messages to the main office.
